summary.intent: Implement SDK client self-bootstrap of folder tree from root IPNS key, eliminating the web layer's responsibility to manually seed folderTree before every folder-dependent SDK operation.
summary.outcome: Added `rootIpnsKeypair` to `CipherBoxClientConfig`, implemented `ensureFolderLoaded` DFS-walk method in the SDK client, wired it into all 10+ folder-dependent method throwers, updated `useAuth.ts` to pass the keypair, and shipped unit tests + an E2E reload-restore spec — all passing typecheck, lint, and 179 SDK unit tests.

repo: `CipherBoxClientConfig` carried `rootIpnsName` (string) and `rootFolderKey` (AES-256) but no root IPNS Ed25519 signing keypair — the gap that prevented any self-bootstrap. The web `vaultStore.rootIpnsKeypair` held it, guarded at `useAuth.ts:281`, but was never forwarded to the SDK.

`FolderState` (not `FolderEntry`) is the folderTree value type; it holds the per-folder Ed25519 `ipnsKeypair` needed for IPNS publishing — non-root folders already received this at registration but root never had an entry.

Child folder entries carry `folderKeyEncrypted` (hex) and `ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` (hex) — must be unwrapped via `unwrapKey` (ECIES) using the parent's `folderKey` to get each child's AES key + signing key for DFS traversal.
`withOperation` is reentrant-safe (pure event emission, no lock) — safe to call `ensureFolderLoaded` (which calls `loadFolder` wrapped in `withOperation`) from inside another `withOperation` call.
`integration.test.ts` is `describe.skip` under `CI=1` — requires a live backend at localhost:3000. Running with `CI=1` cleanly separates the 178 offline unit tests from the live-API suite.

Root `typecheck` script rebuilds the full monorepo dependency chain (`tsc -b`) before running `web` typecheck against built dist — this is the correct typecheck command after any public SDK API change.

The `createFolder` method publishes the new subfolder to IPNS but does NOT insert it into `folderTree` — the caller must subsequently register it if it wants to call folder-dependent methods on the new folder.

code.finding: CipherBoxClientConfig shape — originally no root IPNS keypair field; added `rootIpnsKeypair: { publicKey: Uint8Array; privateKey: Uint8Array }`
FolderState type — holds ipnsKeypair (Ed25519) per folder, children as FolderChild[] union of FilePointer + FolderEntry, no parent pointer
Private fields: vaultKeypair/rootFolderKey stored as internalVaultKeypair/internalRootFolderKey (defensive copies); folderTree is FolderTree class wrapping Map<string, FolderState>
registerFolder — sync entry point that builds FolderState with metadata:null; requires caller to supply ipnsKeypair
loadFolder — async load primitive, returns FolderState | null (not undefined); callers must handle null
restoreFromBin delegates to binOps passing this.folderTree — was the concrete 'Target folder not loaded' bug site after reload because useBin never re-seeded the target folder
Guard ensures rootIpnsKeypair is non-null before SDK init — safe to pass directly into CipherBoxClientConfig without additional null check

workflow: Fan out 5 parallel agents to map codebase subsystems before writing a single line of implementation — the complete upfront map prevents mid-implementation rework.
Complete GSD bookkeeping (todo → completed, STATE.md, git commit) before starting implementation so the planning state stays consistent even if implementation is interrupted.
Spawn a separate adversarial security-review agent after implementation but before the final commit — caught the corrupt-sibling abort path (per-child try/catch hardening) at zero cost.
Use `CI=1` environment variable to isolate offline unit tests from live-API integration suites when verifying regressions.

friction: Type errors on first typecheck pass: `loadFolder` returns `FolderState | null` but local vars in `ensureFolderLoaded` initialized via `.get()` typed as `| undefined` — TS didn't unify them, requiring explicit `let root: FolderState | null = null` declarations.
Prettier auto-formatted the client.ts edits differently than the hand-written style, causing lint to fail and requiring a second `--write` pass before the lint gate cleared.
Integration test failures (live-API suite) initially looked like SDK regressions until confirmed to be environment-only (`describe.skip` under `CI=1`).
open_items: Web-side `ensureFolderRegistered` calls can now be deleted since the SDK self-bootstraps — not cleaned up in this session to keep scope contained.
E2E spec `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` was written and type-checked but not executed against a live browser/backend — needs a Playwright run to confirm the fix end-to-end.
`recycle-bin.spec.ts` still doesn't cover the reload scenario — it was identified as a gap but left in place; the new spec supplements rather than fixes it.

`createFolder` still doesn't insert the newly created subfolder into `folderTree` — a caller using the new subfolder immediately after creation will hit `ensureFolderLoaded` which will reload from IPNS (correct but an extra round-trip); could be optimized to register in-place.
